answer.reason: The verses show the book only as a work cited for the sun standing still and for the teaching of the bow, which gives it a few things the summary does not state.

clauses.english: was cited as the written record of the sun standing still in the midst of heaven
clauses.quote: Is not this written in the book of Jasher?

clauses.english: was cited as the place where the teaching of the bow to the children of Judah was written
clauses.quote: behold, it is written in the book of Jasher.

doubts: The summary already names the sun standing still and the lament, so the clauses may be redundant; the 2SA 1:18 verse links the book to the teaching of the bow, not directly to the lament.
